description: This file defines functions and types for encrypting and decrypting secrets using AES-256-GCM, managing keyrings via environment variables, and handling associated data (AAD). It includes key management, encryption, decryption, and re-encryption logic.

methods.name: stableJson
methods.description: Serializes a value into a stable JSON string with sorted keys.

methods.name: aadToBuffer
methods.description: Converts AAD object to a Buffer using stable JSON serialization.

methods.name: b64url
methods.description: Encodes a Buffer to a base64url string.

methods.name: unb64url
methods.description: Decodes a base64url string to a Buffer.

methods.name: envKeyringPrefix
methods.description: Generates environment variable prefix for a given keyring name, enforcing uppercase.

methods.name: getCurrentKid
methods.description: Retrieves the current key ID (kid) for a given keyring from environment variables.

methods.name: getKeyMaterial
methods.description: Retrieves the encryption key material for a given ring and kid from environment variables.

methods.name: encryptSecret
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext into a SecretEnvelopeV1 using AES-256-GCM with associated data.

methods.name: decryptSecret
methods.description: Decrypts a SecretEnvelopeV1 to retrieve the plaintext.

methods.name: decryptAndMaybeReencrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a secret and re-encrypts it if the current key ID differs from the envelope's key ID.
